Уменьшенные копии текстуры для дальних р: Smaller copies of the texture for long distances. Without them the texture shimmers and flickers from afar. Turn off only for HUD and sprites that are always seen up close. +33% to the file size.
Игрок с низким качеством текстур в настр: Players with low texture quality in their settings still see the full resolution. For signs and small text that would otherwise become unreadable.
Текстура чётче под острым углом: пол, до: Sharper texture at steep angles: floors, roads, a wall seen along its length. Almost free.
Масштабирует без размытия и включает poi: Scales without blurring and turns on point sampling: pixels stay crisp squares. Best together with the BGRA8888 format; DXT blurs the edges of its 4x4 blocks.
Край текстуры не заворачивается на проти: The texture edge doesn't wrap around to the opposite side. Removes the thin strip of the other edge on decals, sprites and icons. Turn it off for tiles that repeat across a wall.
Зеркалит картинку. Если декаль или надпи: Mirrors the picture. Use it when a decal or a sign faces the wrong way in game.
Делает прозрачным фон того же цвета, что: Makes the background transparent if it has the same color as the corners of the picture (white, black, green...). Only background touching the edges is removed: same-colored spots inside the drawing stay.
Срезает полностью прозрачные края до мас: Cuts off fully transparent edges before scaling, so the drawing fills the whole texture. Handy together with "Remove solid background" for stickers and decals.
Невидимые пиксели получают цвет ближайше: Invisible pixels get the color of the nearest visible ones. Removes the white or dark fringe around transparent edges that shows up from a distance (on mipmaps).
Для плоских моделей, листьев, табличек:: For flat models, leaves, signs: without it the polygon is invisible from the back.
Цвет складывается с тем, что позади: чёр: The color is added to whatever is behind it: black becomes transparent, bright parts glow. For fire, flares, neon, holograms. No alpha channel needed.
На этой поверхности не остаются следы пу: Bullet holes, scorch marks and sprays don't appear on this surface. For walls and brushes.
Цвет и прозрачность можно менять из карт: Color and opacity can be changed from the map or a plugin (rendercolor / renderamt). This is how stock TF2 decals are made.
Имя берётся из имени файла, описания кар: The name comes from the file name, the image description on the website, the search query or the image address; hashes and words like images/download are dropped. Turn it off to keep the name fixed (for example, to replace the same texture again and again).
Ctrl+V или перетаскивание сразу создают: Ctrl+V or a drop creates the VTF + VMT at once with the current settings, no Ctrl+S needed. For a stream of many pictures in a row.
Тащишь картинку из браузера или Проводни: Drag a picture from the browser or Explorer onto the Hammer window and a semi-transparent zone appears over it. Drop it over a wall in the 3D view: the program makes the material, picks the right Hammer tool and clicks where you dropped it, so the picture appears on the wall as a decal, a face texture or an overlay ("In Hammer as" below). Then the Selection tool is switched back on. A material with the same name is never overwritten (_2, _3 is added).
Когда в Hammer выделена декаль (infodeca: When a decal (infodecal) is selected in Hammer, a "Decal: [slider] [number] u" panel appears in its title bar. Drag the slider, use the mouse wheel or type a number (Enter): the size is applied to the selected decal at once (Ctrl+Z in Hammer undoes it). Works for decals made by clip2vtf. It is also the size of the next pictures (the same "Decal width in units" field). The "Settings" button on the panel opens every option of the Texture and Material tabs: a change rebuilds the selected decal right away (and applies to the next pictures).
Сохранённый материал сразу становится те: The saved material becomes the current texture in the running Hammer++, you only need to apply it to a face. The program opens Hammer's texture browser, types the name into the filter and picks the tile itself. The material is always copied to the client tf for this: Hammer reads from there. Manually: the "To Hammer" button or Ctrl+H.
Копировать ещё в клиент TF2: Also copy to the TF2 client
Кладёт копию в tf клиента (путь ниже). Н: Puts a copy into the client tf (path below). Needed to see the material in your own game and in Hammer: they don't see the server folder.
Рядом с серверной копией пишутся сжатые: Compressed .vtf.bz2 / .vmt.bz2 files are written next to the server copy: players download them faster. The client copy doesn't need .bz2 files.
Если .bz2 не создаётся, а старый лежит р: If no .bz2 is created but an old one is lying next to the file, it is deleted. Otherwise players would download the old version of the texture: the client always takes the .bz2 first.
После записи файл читается декодером Val: After writing, the file is read back with Valve's decoder and compared with the picture. If it is broken or badly damaged by compression, the status line turns red.
Если материал с таким именем уже есть, с: If a material with this name already exists, ask first.
Если имя занято, к нему добавляется номе: If the name is taken, a number is added to it. The old material stays as it was.
Оригинал картинки в полном размере ляжет: The original picture in full size goes to tf/materialsrc/<folder>/<name>.png, the way Valve keeps its sources. It isn't sent to clients; it is there so you can rebuild the texture later.
Копировать путь материала после сохранен: Copy the material path after saving
В буфер попадёт путь вида папка/имя - вс: A path like folder/name goes to the clipboard, ready to paste into Hammer, a config or plugin code.
После каждого сохранения открывается окн: An Explorer window with the material opens after every save.
Окно программы не прячется за браузером: The program window doesn't hide behind the browser, which makes dragging pictures easy.

Размер \"авто\" = ближайшая степень двой: Size "auto" = the nearest power of two (up to 2048). Format "Auto": DXT1 if there is no transparency, DXT5 otherwise.
Прозрачность \"Авто\": $translucent для: Transparency "Auto": $translucent for smooth alpha, $alphatest for hard alpha (only 0/255). For scale: a player is about 83 units tall.
Декаль (Apply decals): размер задаёт \"Д: Decal (Apply decals): the size is set by "Decal width in units" on the Material tab; it can't be resized with the mouse in Hammer. A brush texture goes onto the face you dropped the picture on. An overlay (Apply overlays) can be stretched by its corners in the 3D view.
Текстура на браш: \"Заполнить\" растягив: Brush texture: "Fill" enlarges the picture without distortion until it covers the whole face (the edges are cut off), "Fit whole picture" until the whole picture fits (the rest of the face is filled with its repeats). Custom scale: 0.25 is like stock textures, 1 is one pixel per unit. Lightmap: a smaller number gives sharper shadows on the picture but costs the map more (default 16).
Табличка на стену: программа сама делает: Sign on the wall: the program builds a brush of the right size and puts it flush against the wall you dropped the picture on. The picture is on the front face, the height follows its proportions. Other faces: nodraw (invisible, as they should be on a wall sign), Hammer's current texture or a custom material - pick it in Hammer's texture browser with the button below.
Ширина текстуры в пикселях. \"авто\" - б: Texture width in pixels. "auto" - the nearest power of two (up to 2048). The decal size in units doesn't change with it: the slider above sets that.
Высота текстуры в пикселях. \"авто\" - п: Texture height in pixels. "auto" - from the picture's proportions.
Как вписать картинку в текстуру другой п: How to fit the picture into a texture of different proportions: stretch it, fit it with transparent margins or crop it to the center.
Сжатие. Авто: DXT1, если нет прозрачност: Compression. Auto: DXT1 if there is no transparency, DXT5 otherwise. BGRA8888 is lossless but 4-8 times larger.
Авто: $translucent для плавной прозрачно: Auto: $translucent for smooth transparency, $alphatest for hard transparency (only 0/255).
